title: SI kind table
description: The kinds a Quantity may declare, with the SI dimension exponent vector and the unprefixed SI unit each one must be stored in. Not a JSON Schema: a data table used by quantity validation (ADR 0001 D1.1-D1.3). `process_runtime.units` carries the same table and tests/test_units_p01.py asserts the two agree exactly. Adding, removing or re-typing a kind is a change to the P01 interface freeze and requires a Fable-authored ADR (docs/interfaces-frozen.md §3).

temperature.notes: Absolute temperature. Distinct from temperature_difference although the dimension is the same (ADR 0001 D1.3). Converting from degC adds 273.15.

temperature_difference.notes: Unbounded. Converting from degC is the identity. `temperature + temperature` is a validation error; see combine_kinds.

molar_flow.notes: The default extensive material variable (ADR 0001 D2.1). Component molar flows are bounded below by 0; that bound is declared per quantity, not implied by the kind.

mass_flow.notes: Derived through the component molecular weights; there is no independent mass state (ADR 0001 D1.4).

heat_rate.notes: Heat duty, positive into the unit (ADR 0001 D4.1). May be negative.

power.notes: Shaft work rate, positive into the unit. Shares a dimension with heat_rate and is a distinct kind.

molar_enthalpy.notes: Comparable only within one provider implementation hash, data hash and reference convention (ADR 0001 D5.2).

mole_fraction.notes: Defined only where total flow is positive (ADR 0001 D2.2, D3.1). Values lie in [0, 1].

dimensionless.notes: Ratios that are not compositions, for example the SYN-001 split fraction r.

molar_heat_capacity.notes: ADDED IN P01 BEYOND THE ADR 0001 D1.3 ENUMERATION, pending Fable's confirmation (docs/progress.md, 'Opus -> Fable, P01 handoff'). The SYN-001 ComponentRecord parameter c_p cannot be expressed with a registered kind otherwise. Dimension-only, exactly as D1.3 describes its non-temperature kinds: no arithmetic rule beyond the dimension check.

molar_volume.notes: ADDED IN P01 BEYOND THE ADR 0001 D1.3 ENUMERATION, pending Fable's confirmation (docs/progress.md, 'Opus -> Fable, P01 handoff'). The SYN-001 ComponentRecord parameter v_i cannot be expressed with a registered kind otherwise. Dimension-only, no new arithmetic rule.
